principle: Photography and video are documentary product content. Search from the exact person/event/place and official source, assign each asset to a semantic slot, preserve provenance, and never replace missing real evidence with generated or unrelated stock media.
forbidden: AI-generated trainer, athlete, child, crowd, camp, venue or event photography presented as real
random stock used as a named federation/event/person/place
face or identity inference from appearance
image-search thumbnails or reposts treated as provenance
another event/year/place captioned as the target event
generic promotional filler used instead of factual captions
invented quotes, achievements, biographies or event stories
source_priority: Nizhny Novgorod Shinkyokushinkai federation official publication
Красный Плёс official site / official album for camp content
named photographer or directly connected publication with explicit binding
generic stock only for genuinely non-specific atmosphere

search_method.rule: Search engines discover the original source page; they are never the source of record.
search_method.before_search: Define the media slot job first.
search_method.after_find: Record source page, publisher, subject, date/context, identity status when relevant, crop intent and fallback.

slots.job: Show real physical training/camp activity immediately, not a decorative river photograph.
slots.preferred_evidence: Official Красный Плёс training video or exact-event federation media.
slots.source_context: The official archive entry dated 04.06.2026 embeds VID_20260605_092450.mp4, VID_20260605_092455.mp4 and VID_20260605_092458.mp4.
slots.crop: Full-bleed action; keep the active subject inside the central mobile-safe region.
slots.fallback: Intentional dark/typographic hero state; never a broken image or unrelated substitute.

slots.job: Document different classes of camp evidence rather than repeat one poster.

slots.identity_requirement: The source must explicitly bind the image to that exact person.
slots.fallback: Typography/initials poster. No generic club photo may masquerade as a portrait.

slots.job: Show actual federation training, competition or instructional culture.
slots.notes: Federation publications include dated training/competition reports and photographer attribution. Use those exact reports for federation-specific evidence rather than generic martial-arts stock.

keep: Official Красный Плёс 2026 photo album link
Official federation source for source-bound Georgiy Pigidанов portrait
Typography fallback for trainers without verified portraits

reject.reason: The river photograph is real but semantically weak as a training-video poster and is not the source of the training event. It must not be repeated across every camp video as if it documented those clips.

next_search_targets: Exact source-bound portraits for trainers from official federation/team/profile publications
Distinct official camp stills for place/community slots
Federation training and competition action frames with dated source pages

copy_policy.rule: Use project data or source wording/facts. Do not invent emotional slogans to compensate for weak evidence.
copy_policy.ui_microcopy_exception: Navigation, buttons and ordinary interface labels may be written normally as interface copy.

done_when: Every critical media slot has a semantic job and provenance.
No unrelated repeated poster substitutes for exact evidence.
Desktop/mobile crops preserve the evidence selected for each slot.
Critical remote media fails into intentional UI.
Rendered media can be traced back to its original source page.
